data.title: Will AI take my job? Ask an economist!
data.description: Is AI coming for our jobs? Join Adrian Ma, co-host of The Indicator from Planet Money, for a virtual event featuring two economists at the center of this debate: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning professor at MIT, and Ronnie Chatterji, Chief Economist at OpenAI. We'll invite you to share your thoughts and ask questions.
